name: My Sweet Home
source:
A boy and a girl have to live at the same place regardless of their desires with father-in-law. They only watched at each other at a distance. But at some point it came down to ambiguous relationship.  The boy and the girl fell in love with each other as they grew up.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩和一个女孩无论公公的意愿如何都必须住在同一个地方。他们只是远远地看着对方。但在某些时候，它归结为暧昧的关系。男孩和女孩在成长过程中彼此相爱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
